correctness.rationale: For every N>=5 with primitive progression, reindexing reduces to five distinct delay rows. The exact row polynomials give two full rows, two conjugate-root two-term rows each losing e frequencies, and a positive-real-coefficient quadratic central row losing h. The nonreal unit roots occur as a conjugate pair exactly at equal endpoint mass and the stated negative-cosine frequency; the only real sampled root is -1 in even orders, when middle mass equals the sum of endpoint masses. These mutually exclusive cases prove S=5N-2e-h and all sharp equality cases without numerical assumptions. All five even-order and three odd-order levels have explicit witnesses. The extracted checker corroborates 560 cases and is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The complete three-tap self-ambiguity support spectrum is a natural first genuinely phase-sensitive class beyond two-point windows. It determines all possible cardinalities for all cyclic orders >=5, exhibits two forbidden near-maximum support levels exactly in odd orders, and gives a sharp necessary-and-sufficient amplitude/phase criterion for the most concentrated case. This extends beyond the previously known prime-order lower bound and gives structural frequency cancellation information relevant to exact time-frequency localization.
